script_text: A dramatic cosmic shake-up targets your balance this week, Libra. As an Air sign ruled by Venus, you'll feel Monday's Sun in your 10th House square Saturn in your 7th House, making it your worst day as work clashes with partnership. Tuesday brings relief when Venus sextiles Mars in your 2nd House, sparking financial gains and flirtatious charm. Midweek Venus enters your 5th House of romance on Wednesday, shifting your heart toward playful love and marking your power day. Late week Jupiter enters Leo your 11th House on Thursday, expanding networks and visibility, while weekend Sun trine Neptune sweetens intuitive money moves. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of love. Monday is your worst day because Sun square Saturn strains your 10th and 7th House obligations. Launch that joint venture with a partner before Thursday's Jupiter boost. Follow for daily updates.
